tools.name: get_ielts_model_answer
tools.description: Fetch one full IELTS Writing model answer from KeenIELTS: the complete question, the student's full answer, and the AI examiner evaluation with per-criterion band scores and feedback.

tools.name: open_practice_section
tools.description: Navigate this KeenIELTS tab to a practice area so the user can start practicing: listening, reading, writing, speaking, drills, or model-answers.

tools.name: search_ielts_model_answers
tools.description: Search real student IELTS Writing model answers on KeenIELTS, each scored by an AI examiner on the official IELTS marking criteria. Returns band-scored samples with question and answer excerpts plus section_id/attempt_id for fetching the full answer.

bands.description: Band filter: "All" (default), a single band like "7", or a range like "6-8"
